---
title: "Aggregate states"
subtitle: "Sum across all eight Australian states and territories"
---

```{r setup}
#| include: false
library(targets)
library(dplyr)
library(plotly)
library(reactable)
library(htmltools)
tar_source("R")

agg <- tryCatch(tar_read(facts_aggregate), error = function(e) tibble::tibble())

status_lbl <- function(b) as.character(ifelse(b, "Forecast", "Actual"))
```

::: {.callout-note}
Aggregate views sum each jurisdiction's most-recent value per
fiscal year. Coverage is partial while extraction is still being
backfilled --- see `n_states` in the table for how many states
contributed to each row.
:::

## Net debt --- all states summed

```{r netdebt}
if (nrow(agg) == 0L) {
  htmltools::p("No aggregate panel yet.")
} else {
  d <- agg |>
    filter(variable_id == "net_debt") |>
    arrange(fiscal_year) |>
    mutate(status = status_lbl(is_forward_estimate))
  plot_ly(d,
          x = ~fiscal_year, y = ~value_aud_mil,
          color = ~status,
          colors = c(Actual = "#1f3a93", Forecast = "#a6611a"),
          type = "scatter", mode = "lines+markers",
          line = list(width = 3),
          hovertemplate = "<b>%{x}</b><br>%{y:,.0f} AUD mil<extra></extra>") |>
    plotly::layout(
      title  = "All states --- net debt",
      font   = list(family = "Inter, system-ui, sans-serif", size = 12L),
      legend = list(orientation = "h", x = 0, y = -0.18, title = list(text = "")),
      margin = list(l = 60L, r = 20L, t = 50L, b = 70L),
      xaxis  = list(title = "", tickangle = -45),
      yaxis  = list(title = "AUD millions", tickformat = ",")
    )
}
```

## Total revenue --- all states summed

```{r rev}
if (nrow(agg) == 0L) {
  htmltools::p("No data.")
} else {
  d <- agg |>
    filter(variable_id == "rev_total") |>
    arrange(fiscal_year) |>
    mutate(status = status_lbl(is_forward_estimate))
  plot_ly(d,
          x = ~fiscal_year, y = ~value_aud_mil,
          color = ~status,
          colors = c(Actual = "#1f3a93", Forecast = "#a6611a"),
          type = "scatter", mode = "lines+markers",
          line = list(width = 3),
          hovertemplate = "<b>%{x}</b><br>%{y:,.0f} AUD mil<extra></extra>") |>
    plotly::layout(
      title  = "All states --- total revenue",
      font   = list(family = "Inter, system-ui, sans-serif", size = 12L),
      legend = list(orientation = "h", x = 0, y = -0.18, title = list(text = "")),
      margin = list(l = 60L, r = 20L, t = 50L, b = 70L),
      xaxis  = list(title = "", tickangle = -45),
      yaxis  = list(title = "AUD millions", tickformat = ",")
    )
}
```

## Aggregate fact table

```{r}
if (nrow(agg) == 0L) {
  htmltools::p("Empty.")
} else {
  agg |>
    arrange(canonical_label, fiscal_year) |>
    transmute(
      Variable = canonical_label,
      FY       = fiscal_year,
      `Sum (AUD mil)` = round(value_aud_mil),
      `States summed` = n_states,
      Status = status_lbl(is_forward_estimate)
    ) |>
    reactable(
      defaultPageSize = 15,
      searchable      = TRUE,
      filterable      = TRUE,
      striped         = TRUE,
      columns = list(
        `Sum (AUD mil)` = colDef(format = colFormat(separators = TRUE))
      )
    )
}
```
